# Summy Garden Studio

> AI headshot generator for job seekers. Upload about 8 phone photos and get 30
> studio-quality professional headshots in minutes, for LinkedIn, CVs and job
> applications. Built for Hong Kong and Asia as well as the West: 11 languages,
> 5 currencies, and professional wardrobe that includes cheongsam, hijab and
> mandarin-collar options as ordinary choices rather than novelties.

Site: https://summygarden.com/

## What it does

You upload around 8 photos of yourself taken on a phone (3 is the minimum). The
studio automatically picks the 3 sharpest, most varied shots as references, then
generates 30 finished headshots. You choose up to 6 themes from 100 scenes
across 10 collections, and the shoot is split evenly between them — the exact
scenes are shown before you generate. Optionally you also pick an outfit from
78, including cheongsam, hijab and mandarin collar.

Everything else is automatic and deliberately not adjustable. Lighting, camera
angle and colour grade rotate across the 30 photos, and your own head angle and
facial expression are preserved rather than replaced. Services that let you pin
a single pose or expression apply it to every photo at once, which reduces
variety and is a common cause of results that do not look like the customer.

Every generated photo is checked against your uploaded photos using on-device
face recognition. Any photo whose likeness drifts past a set threshold is
re-shot before you ever see it. Previews are watermarked; downloads are clean
4K files.

## Pricing

One-time credit packs. No subscription. Credits never expire. One credit is one
shoot of 30 finished photos.

| Pack | Price (USD) | Shoots | Photos |
|---|---|---|---|
| Essential | $24 | 1 | 30 |
| Professional | $39 | 3 | 90 |
| Studio | $59 | 6 | 180 |

Also priced in GBP, HKD, EUR and RMB. Every pack carries a 30-day quality
guarantee: if the photos do not look like you, or are not of a professional
standard, email us within 30 days and we review the photos your shoot produced.
The usual remedy is a free re-shoot, with a refund where the results genuinely
fall short. Reviews are carried out by a person and decided case by case, so
this is a quality guarantee rather than an unconditional money-back guarantee.
Statutory rights are unaffected.

## How it differs from other AI headshot services

- **Ready in minutes, not hours.** Most competitors fine-tune a per-customer
  model, which takes 1–2 hours. Summy Garden uses in-context reference images
  instead, so a shoot completes in minutes.
- **Automatic likeness verification.** Generated photos are face-matched against
  your uploads and re-shot if they drift. This is not standard in the category.
- **Genuinely multilingual.** The whole product — not just a translated landing
  page — works in English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Hindi,
  Arabic, French, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese and German.
- **Wardrobe beyond Western business wear.** Cheongsam, hijab and mandarin
  collar are ordinary professional options. They are never assigned
  automatically — you choose them.
- **Local currency pricing** for the UK, Hong Kong, the US, Europe and China.

## Privacy

Photos are used only to generate your headshots. They are never used to train
any AI model and are never sold. Generated headshots are stored privately in
your dashboard and deleted automatically after 6 months. Source photos are not
retained after your shoot. Payments are handled by Stripe; card details are
never visible to us.

## Honest limitations

- Summy Garden Studio launched in 2026 and does not yet have a large body of
  published customer reviews.
- Results depend on the photos you upload. Heavily filtered, backlit, low
  resolution or distant photos produce weaker likeness.
- It generates photographs of you in different clothing, lighting and settings.
  It does not replace a photographer for editorial or full-body work.
